predeclaration.text:
2026-10-27; before all new formal performance measurements.
DeepSeek reference selected full official SDK, not sdk-minimal, after source
inspection found native checkpoint-policy/projection-cache present only in SDK.
The supported sdk-source patch is used as documented by the official launcher.
Its completion, close, resume and notification differences are recorded in
benchmarks/runtime/deepseek-reference.md and native result contracts. In
particular SDK idle does not await final flush, so no equal-durability ratio or
complete-lifecycle rank is allowed. This refines the preliminary experiment.txt
selection; sdk-minimal functional/setup logs remain diagnostic only.

Candidate E, separately staged after D: replace eagerly materialized scalar
field pages for <=16KiB request scalar with existing authenticated original
byte index. Retain eager validation and derive scalar inspection fields once
per external operation. Larger scalar uses existing indexed path. Schema77,
no migration. Must pass differential/invalid/corruption/reopen tests and same
six-case/two-mode/three-alternating-pair matrix against retained stage. Apply
the same predeclared retention criterion as D; preserve adverse outcomes.

decision: requires_review: evidence audit does not predetermine retention; assess runtime outcomes together with correctness and the separate Reader tradeoff diagnostic
limits: No new executions, builds, profiles, or timing samples.
Build and source identities verified; external-machine scheduling interference cannot be reconstructed from these files.
Controller correctness validators rerun from retained raw data; independent expected wire history additionally checked.
Only three alternating pairs; reported Student-t log-ratio intervals depend on unverified distribution/independence assumptions and are not parity evidence.
Self CPU is quantized at 10ms; complete CPU is absolute through cleanup, including startup, harness, and verification.
Writes are process-attributed and memory is maximum sampled PSS/RSS, not device I/O or peak allocation.
This is E versus retained D. D already contains counting plus readiness coalescing; do not reassign those changes an E timing benefit.
The ordinary runtime lifecycle does not cover all explicit scalar field/page reads. This audit alone cannot establish acceptable Reader latency or make the retention decision.
The copied optimized diagnostic libtest is excluded from production artifact counting. Reader timings use that cfg(test) binary and are not production B/E end-to-end measurements.
